posts.name: EricAlexWTG
posts.cooked: Seriously, thanks for making it. Picked it up when I heard about it on the Dice Tower podcast and have been having a ton of fun so far. We’ve been going random on everything, we pick a random villain on a random environment against four random heroes. So far, we lost badly to General Voss, beat Omnitron (basic), beat Omnitron (advanced) with half the party KO’ed, and beat Baron Blade (advanced). Blade would have won if it weren’t for some well timed Brain Burns from Visionary! I love how each villain and hero is so unique. Great, great design.

Many many thanks for this great game!
